title: The Libraries.....anyone been in these?
content: I have been in several different libraries. I'm going to get one out of the way because it's a typical looking library. It's large but looks like any other library would. Except for maybe the various mirrors that bounce a laser around the place to detect ghosts. ok so the first one appeared to at one time been a huge cathedral. A church. It looks like it from the outside. On the inside as well. As you go in, to the left, are a row of table, one right after the other and seems to go on and on. on the opposite of these tables are the rows and rows of aisles full of books. This place is huge. It seems to go on and on and the book shelfs just go up and up to infinity. The place is dark, and it seems to be illuminated by small torches on the walls. very medieval. There are also suits of armor through out the place. Two near the entrance. A few here and there against the walls between the tables and more at the end of all the book shelfs. there also seems to be a large fireplace at the very end but I never seem to get near it. There are often people sitting here and there reading. The 2nd and 3rd ones are connected but are very different from one another. you have to get through one to get to the other. the first one is small in appearance, and I've only seen the inside. The walls are wooden. the main area is circular and there are a ton of large wooden tables. some have computers on them. The walls all around are actually bookshelves. They seem to go up 6 stories or more. Give or take. The only way up is using the huge spiral staircase that is in the far back of the library. It's also made of wood. Directly behind this, is a caged elevator. This elevator takes you to the upper floors or directly to other library. Everyone in this library seem to be working there. As if they are part of some group working in secrecy in this place. There are two people that seem to be in charge. One is an old man. He's always dressed in a dark business suit with a black tie. He has grey hair but bald on top. He seems to be nice. Then there's a young woman who appears to be in her early twenties. She has dark shoulder length hair. She's usually wearing a sweater. Always a different color. She is also wearing a black skirt. Every time I've come to this place I seem to have been hired by them and they want me to be some kind of security guard. We get on the elevator and we do down several floor. We exit out into what looks like a large security room. There are large windows that look out to this underground library. There are also a bunch of tv monitors in here. I'm told this is a secret library and that I can't tell anyone about it. The place is huge. Like it goes on and on and on. It's all white, sterile. Sanitized. Everything is clean. It's half a library and half a museum. There are artifacts in here enclosed in glass cabinets. weapons of all kinds are here. masks from all over the world. Ancient things including books. There are rows and rows of books. Aisle upon aisle. They always tell me that everything in this place is dangerous and no one can touch them. That the things in here can instantly kill you with one touch. The books here seem to contain incantations and I cannot read them. they then take me to another smaller room. A vault. It seems that the more dangerous artifacts are kept here, especially things like jewelry in small boxes. But there are books and similar things like the main library. After a while we have to rush out and back to the security center. They tell me that if we stay out there too long we will get influenced by evil and maybe even die. These are the only libraries I keep going back to. Not that I want to go to them. But I tend to end up in them from time to time. Anyone been to libraries like these?
